title: Frankfurt Book Fair 2024
excerpt: Our first stand at the heart of international publishing: five days of rights meetings introducing our children’s and adult lists.
image_alt: Our team at our first stand at the Frankfurt Book Fair 2024
body: Cold, rainy weather welcomed us to the Frankfurt Book Fair on 16–20 October 2024, but the excitement of opening our first stand at the heart of international publishing soon took over. Following [our debut in Bologna](/news/bologna-childrens-book-fair-2024/) earlier that year, Frankfurt marked our second major fair with our own stand and a new opportunity to introduce both our children’s and adult lists to international colleagues. With Italy as Guest of Honour and more than 4,300 exhibitors taking part, the fair provided an inspiring setting for five days of conversations and discovery. A busy schedule of rights meetings brought fresh perspectives, promising connections and opportunities for our authors’ stories to travel into new languages. We returned with plenty of inspiration, a long list of follow-up emails and English samples to prepare; the work of turning those first conversations into lasting publishing partnerships was just beginning.
